key_result: Shared psychosis liability plus schizophrenia-predominant and bipolar-predominant components; schizoaffective is a boundary-stress category; transdiagnostic biotypes cross diagnoses.
MDD, GAD, PTSD and fear disorders share strong liability, while fear-distress substructure and disorder-specific components remain.
ASD, ADHD and Tourette share liability but retain differentiating loci, diagnostic-boundary drift, rare-variant pathways and disorder-specific structure.
OCD-related disorders separate into compulsivity and grooming dimensions; OCD/AN/Tourette share biology but retain substantial specificity, including AN metabolic biology.
Disinhibition/externalizing is strongly supported; SUDs retain substance-specific and internalizing components; personality pathology cross-loads.

Genetic, immune, neurologic, metabolic/endocrine, infectious, toxic and neurodegenerative diseases can present psychiatrically and should peel off when causal gates are met; testing yield is context-dependent.
